annotations.title: Roll Tabletop RPG NPC & VTT Exports

description: Deterministically roll a complete tabletop RPG / D&D NPC (name, ancestry, role, traits, quirk, plot hook, GM secret, portrait prompt, matched voice sample MP3, and a <=75-char greeting tuned for the free 5s talking video clip), plus ready-to-import SillyTavern Character Card V2 JSON and Foundry VTT NPC Actor JSON. Public zero-cost tool — requires NO API key and charges 0 credits.

ancestry.description: Optional ancestry filter or custom ancestry, e.g. "Dwarven", "Elven", "Half-orc", "Halfling", "Gnomish", "Fey-touched", "Tiefling".

exportFormat.description: Output export format: "all" (default, includes both SillyTavern Character Card V2 and Foundry VTT Actor JSON), "summary", "sillytavern", or "foundry".

role.description: Optional tabletop role filter or custom archetype, e.g. "Tavern keeper", "Runesmith", "Hedge alchemist", "Harbor smuggler", "Wandering bard".

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed (e.g. "forge26a" or "42"). Same seed always produces the exact same NPC; omit to roll a fresh random seed.

style.description: Visual portrait style preset (default "fantasy"). Supports fantasy, anime, 3d-cartoon (or aliases cartoon / 3d), pixel-art, cyberpunk, watercolor, realistic, professional-headshot.

name: roll_rpg_npc
